description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Campaign class, which manages campaign data, validation, permissions, and statistics retrieval in an advertising server system.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Campaign
classes.description: Class for managing campaign data, validation, permissions, and statistics in an ad server system.

methods.name: _setCampaignDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates a CampaignInfo object with data from an array, converting timestamps and handling revenue fields.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates campaign data, checking required fields, date order, and logical consistency.

methods.name: _validateForStatistics
methods.description: Validates campaign ID and date range for statistics queries.

methods.name: checkStatisticsPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view campaign statistics.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Creates or updates a campaign record after validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a campaign record after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: getCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves campaign info for a given campaign ID.

methods.name: getCampaignListByAdvertiserId
methods.description: Retrieves list of campaigns for a specific advertiser.

methods.name: getCampaignDailyStatistics
methods.description: Fetches daily statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: getCampaignHourlyStatistics
methods.description: Fetches hourly statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: getCampaignBannerStatistics
methods.description: Fetches banner statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: getCampaignPublisherStatistics
methods.description: Fetches publisher statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: getCampaignZoneStatistics
methods.description: Fetches zone statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: getCampaignConversionStatistics
methods.description: Fetches conversion statistics for a campaign over a date range.

methods.name: _isHighPriority
methods.description: Determines if a campaign has high priority based on its priority value.

methods.name: _hasWeight
methods.description: Checks if a campaign has a weight greater than zero.

methods.name: _hasTargets
methods.description: Checks if a campaign has target impressions, clicks, or conversions set.
